001: Let me introduce you to my mother, her name is Carmen.
Hello, Carmen! Nice to meet you. I'm Javier.
My mother is a music teacher.
How interesting! Does she play any instruments?
Yes, she plays the piano and the violin.
That's great! I would love to hear her play.
002: Do you have any siblings, Diego?
Yes, I have an older brother and a younger sister.
My brother's name is Luis, and my sister's name is Ana.
003: This is a picture of my family.
My parents and my two grandparents.
She's my cousin Lucia, she's five years old.
How cute! She looks a lot like you.
004: My father works at a hospital.
Oh, really? And what does he do there?
He's a nurse in the emergency room.
Wow, that must be a very tough job.
Yes, but he loves helping people.
005: Eighty! And how do you plan to celebrate it?
We're going to have a family meal at home.
What a lovely plan. Congratulations to her!
006: Do you live with your parents?
No, I live alone now, but I see them every week.
They live near the city center, twenty minutes from here.
That's nice, so you can visit them whenever you want.
Yes, honestly, it's a stroke of luck.
007: My older sister is getting married next month.
Congratulations! And where will the wedding be?
At a country estate near Toledo.
How beautiful! And what dress will she wear?
A very elegant white one, classic style.
008: Yes, quite big. We have a lot of get-togethers.
And how many of you are there in total?
There are twelve cousins and eight aunts and uncles.
Yeah, we never get bored at parties.
009: My uncle Carlos lives in Valencia.
And what does he do there?
He has a fruit shop at the market.
That's great! And do you go visit him often?
Yes, we go two or three times a year.
How lucky to have family on the coast.
010: Do you know my cousin Marta?
No, I don't think so. What is she like?
She's tall, dark-haired, and very friendly.
And what does she like to do?
She loves traveling and taking pictures.
Well, I'd like to meet her someday.
